title: Prompt2ParametricCAD portfolio showcase
description: Five deterministic design-intent examples chosen to demonstrate the project's current mechanical CAD vocabulary.

cases.title: Patterned mounting plate
cases.prompt: Create a 100 mm by 70 mm rectangular plate that is 8 mm thick with a 2 by 3 grid of 5 mm through holes centered on the top face.

cases.title: Sealed circular flange
cases.prompt: Create a circular flange with eight bolt holes and a shallow circular O-ring groove around the center opening.

cases.title: Half-cylinder cradle
cases.prompt: Create a half-cylinder cradle sitting on a separate rectangular mounting plate with two circular through holes in the plate and a shallow groove along the curved cradle.

cases.title: Turned shaft with collars and grooves
cases.prompt: Create a cylindrical shaft with two narrow grooves near one end, a larger collar near the other end, and a chamfer on both shaft ends.

cases.title: D-shaped mounting plate
cases.prompt: Create a D-shaped plate with a flat back edge and rounded front, two rectangular side tabs, and three circular through holes along the centerline.
